verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a dedicated month-end close feature (AI Close) that uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies, and it has its own bank and credit-card reconciliation workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows a checklist structure, close tasks for tracking accruals, or reviewer sign-offs. Missing for 10: a documented close checklist with task tracking, accrual tracking within the close, review sign-off/approval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
